events.prTitle: docs(examples): document env var handling in the Docker examples
events.author: icyJoseph
events.commentBody:
Change:
```mdx
Every value has to be present while `next build`
```

events.prTitle: docs(skills): preserve prefetched UI during Partial Prefetching adoption
events.author: aurorascharff
events.commentBody:
I think we can shrink wrap this section. Right now it reads like a Skill summary, rather than a reference for a reader. 

It is also introduces "preservation test" as a concept. 

The snippet below is just a broad suggestion.

```suggestion
### Preserve existing prefetched UI

An [`instant()`](/docs/app/guides/instant-navigation#prevent-regressions-with-e2e-tests) test locks in what a navigation shows immediately. With `partialPrefetching` off, write a client-navigation test for each audited link that asserts the UI you chose to preserve, and confirm it passes.

Then adopt the destination and rerun the same test unchanged. A failure names UI the App Shell no longer carries, so you can cache the data or subtree that restores it. A passing test stays as regression coverage.
```

I am not sure we need the content in 102 and 104  — 102 could go into the API reference for instant. The content in 104, reads like a Skill instruction/pre-condition, more, idk, suddenly it gets very specific.

classification.summary: Clarifies the purpose of the section and suggests restructuring to improve clarity and focus.

events.prTitle: Port React's @gate test directive to the e2e harness
events.author: acdlite
events.commentBody:
is "1" here a number or a boolean? It's a bit ambiguous because sometimes we also refer to the groups as shards. telling tests to only run if the test is in a specific bucket out of the 7 we split tests into would basically mean you want to test it randomly. If it's a boolean, we can use `'true'` instead matching existing flags we set in CI.

Also let's avoid saying "both CI runs" because the same test runs more than twice. We also have bundler, React version and Adapter as a test dimension.

classification.summary: Clarifies ambiguous use of '1' as a number or boolean and suggests using 'true' for consistency with existing CI flags.
